name: Morgan Freeman (BLOCKED - real person)
sounds_like: Very low male at 85 Hz but bright on top (centroid 2069 Hz) with the most audible breath of any male voice here (flatness 0.0112, only 24% of frames voiced) - that combination of deep fundamental and airy overtones is the characteristic sound. Slow at 4.3 onsets per second with a wide 27.8 dB loudness range. Source is a 2008 BBC Radio 4 interview about being perceived to embody gravitas.
avoid_for: All casting, particularly the authoritative narration this file exists to imitate. Use male_02 for a deep calm narrator.
note: BLOCKED - this is a voice clone of a real, identifiable person. This project craft notes say these must not be cast, and that holds regardless of the CC-BY 3.0 licence on the source recording: the licence covers redistributing the audio clip, not synthesising new speech in that person voice and putting words in their mouth. A card exists only so nobody rediscovers the file and casts it by accident. Do not set this to ready. Source: BBC Radio 4 The Film Programme, 12 Sep 2008, via Wikimedia Commons.
